summary: Tested SMS Provider Database Caching feature (iteration 18). Virtual Numbers page works correctly with 5 dropdown options: US Server, International, Global, US Numbers (NEW), Other Countries (NEW). US Numbers shows 4 provider cards with GENERIC names (Premium Server, Server 1, Budget Server, Fast Server). Other Countries shows 3 provider cards with GENERIC names (Server 1, Budget Server, Fast Server). Real provider names (Text Verified, 5sim, SMS Bower, Tiger SMS) are NOT visible to users. Tiger SMS has 20,960 services cached across 200 countries. SMS Bower requires API key configuration. Admin panel has 'Sync Provider Services' card working correctly.
